newsitem.title: USA: Presstek sued for issuing false statement.
newsitem.headline: Presstek sued for issuing false statement.

text.p: A lawsuit has been filed against Presstek Inc on June 16 in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Hampshire for the reporting of misleading financial statements, said the plaintiff's lawyers.

The complaint alleges that Presstek, Cabot Heritage Corp and others related to them issued false and misleading financial statements which overstated the financial condition of Presstek causing the price of Presstek securities to be artificially inflated..
Seena Silverman filed the lawsuit seeking class action status for all persons or entities who sold put options on the common stock of Presstek Inc between November 7, 1995 and June 20, 1996.
Presstek offers proprietary nonphotographic digital imaging and printing plate technology.
